args.title: checkout-api failing health checks after v2.3.1 deploy — rolled back to v2.3.0
args.summary: checkout-api was failing health checks in all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) after the v2.3.1 deploy, with an error rate of 18%. Actions taken: rolled the service back in all production regions to v2.3.0, the most recent release that was healthy in production. The first rollback attempt partially failed (orchestrator halted after us-east, leaving us-west and eu-west on v2.3.1); a retry completed the rollout to all three regions. Current version is v2.3.0 everywhere. Next steps: investigate root cause of v2.3.1 regression and the orchestrator error during the first rollback attempt.
